name: Aligned Data Centers

profile.reading: This facility is attributed to Aligned Data Centers. This registry separately lists an Aligned operator record (7 facilities) using the shortened company name; the two are very likely the same company. Aligned own site confirms active operations across North America and Latin America, describing 87 data centers with 6.4 gigawatts of operational and planned capacity spread across 51 campuses, with North America markets including Northern Virginia, Chicago, Dallas, Phoenix, Salt Lake City, Maryland, Ohio, Atlanta, Hillsboro, and Abernathy, Texas. The company emphasizes closed loop cooling, 100 percent renewable energy matching in North America, and recently broke ground on Project Caprock, a 540 megawatt campus in Northwest Texas. No founding date, headquarters, ownership structure, or building specific address and MW figures for this particular row were located in available sourcing this session.
profile.research_note: Very likely the same company as the separate Aligned (7 rows) and Aligned Data Centers, LLC (1 row) operator records in this registry; flagged for reconciliation.

This operator row, named Aligned Data Centers, is the full legal name of the same company tracked elsewhere in this registry under the shortened name Aligned, uid b0a914ea, where the complete profile is recorded: a Dallas, Texas headquartered operator previously owned by Macquarie Asset Management and, as of this research date, the subject of a pending approximately $40 billion acquisition by the AI Infrastructure Partnership, MGX, and BlackRock's Global Infrastructure Partners, announced October 2025 with closing expected in the first half of 2026.

Rather than deleting or merging this row into the other Aligned entry, it is kept intact per this assignment's rule against deleting registry data, and cross-linked as a duplicate_of the canonical Aligned row. Reconciling which of the 3 facilities tracked under this row's name and the 7 facilities tracked under the other Aligned row belong to the same physical buildings is left to the facility-level research phase of this assignment.

The registry tracks these 3 Aligned Data Centers-named facilities across two states, Oregon and Texas.
